snippet.title: Twelve Weeks – Official Release Trailer | The Last of Us Part II Multiplayer Mod
snippet.description:
Twelve Weeks is out now: free, fan-made multiplayer for The Last of Us Part II Remastered on PC. Inspired by the original PvP mode.

Pick a side, gather supplies and keep your clan alive. Every match feeds your survivors, and every loss costs them.

▶ Download (free): https://twelve-weeks.com
▶ Discord: https://discord.gg/wmVgW2wxge

This trailer is a shot-for-shot tribute to the 2013 multiplayer reveal, rebuilt with Twelve Weeks gameplay.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
CHAPTERS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
0:00 Intro
0:22 A Battle for Supplies / Craft Your Weapons
0:45 Upgrade Your Arsenal / Protect Your Faction
1:01 Build Your Clan
1:14 Customize Your Survivor / Prove Your Worth
1:27 No One Left Behind

Mod and Trailer Made by Kellie.
